'''Akana-Tok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Disobeying the order to avoid the [[Nightmare Lands]], he and a few other commandos ventured into the forbidden territory and were corrupted by the darkness within. The [[Voss (species)|Voss]] asked an accomplished outsider to follow their trail and put the corrupted out of their misery, which was accomplished by [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Akana-Tok appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of four NPCs required to kill for the heroic "Cleanse the Corrupted."<ref name="SWTOR" />
